name: pitwall
description: A pit wall for your Claude Code sessions: every session on this machine, which ones wait on you, and why

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the panel reads the other sessions: 2 to 120 seconds, 5 by default.

approvalCheck.title: Approval word check
approvalCheck.description: Which messages are refused when they mention push, PR, merge, deploy or prod. off (default): none, so a warning like "don't deploy, we are in a demo" goes through. drafted: what the coordinator's model writes. strict: every message, yours included. A session waiting on an approval never takes a message either way, and what the model drafts always needs your yes.

stuckMinutes.title: Stuck after (minutes)
stuckMinutes.description: A session waiting on you for longer than this gets a stuck badge, and its section counts it. 5 by default, 0 turns the badge off.

stuckNotify.title: Notify when stuck
stuckNotify.description: Also raise a native notification, once per wait, when a session turns stuck. On by default.

closedDays.title: Keep closed fronts (days)
closedDays.description: How long a front with no open session stays under Closed: 1 to 7 days, 1 by default. ✕ Close hides one sooner; resuming it brings it back.
